answer: Joining requires a bond backed by an established agent's vouch locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. Proof of vouching for a transaction without checking it comes from spot-checks against the chain. Once the fault is proven, the bond is slashed in tiers: ten percent first offence, fifty percent second, all of it third. The nectar of the ledger holds every bond in plain sight. No sonnet hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. The wander keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
